**WM-26 — Hops and Attention.** *Rule.* The hop is **always allowed** during a TELL or BREACH (it is the escape verb, AT:73); this system pushes **no stimulus** (it makes 0 `push_stimulus` calls; the berth's single declared LOUD report is Interaction's, see "The berth is not silent to the Web" below) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling G1)*; the pod's running light is cosmetic presentation, not an eligible emitter (ASK-A1, accepted: AT-22 and AT V13 hold `held_ring` 1 for a hop between two ring-1 loci and count the pod's lights only if authored as an eligible FIXTURE, which they are not). Departure does not abort a TELL (AT-22): the clock, the bed and the beats run through the hop, and `tell_epoch`, `tell_len` and `breach_due_T` are unchanged. **The departure void (Resolved 2026-10-27 — user ruling, design-review decisions, Attention OQ-AT-12; Attention AT-22 and E-23 state it):** if the locus body is not the home-ship body and every seat recorded in it at TELL entry has left it by the due run (Attention's `locus_vacated`, derivable from Body's `body_of_actor` / `actor_section` and the IN_POD state of the Controller), the due run is an ABORT: TELL to CALM, `tell_outcome` ABORTED, no STRESS on any body, no beacon, `rearm_until_T` set, release cue. This system's departure dormancy (WM-10 step 1, WM-24) never re-points the locus: Attention suppresses its dormancy fallback from the first run at which `locus_vacated` holds (AT-14, AT-22, E-27; AC-AT-46 clause 1), so a hop never moves a breach onto the home ship the player escaped to, and this system makes no Attention call for it. The fallback to the home ship's lowest `section_id` remains only for a cut, a berth release or a dormancy while a living seat is still in the body (AT E-27). A living seat that stays in the locus body keeps the breach on that body. **A home-ship locus is not voidable** (user ruling OQ-AT-12 (2): 'the lights you left on' are the price): a hop from a tell centred on the home ship does not end it, the due run breaches on the home ship, including with nobody aboard (Attention E-73). BREACH ends when the last recorded occupant leaves a locus body that is not the home body, derivable now from Body's `body_of_actor`, so no notification from this system is needed for correctness. ASK-A4 (hold the TELL-to-STRESS transfer while no seat is aboard home) was DECLINED by Attention (AT-22, E-73) and is closed here. What is frozen across a hop is the derelict's own Graph and Horror state (WM-25), not the tell, which is Attention's. *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix, conformed to Attention AT-22 / E-23 / E-73)* The option "LOUD on departure" (the hop itself becomes a stimulus) is recorded as a **default-off** knob routed to Attention (`HOP_LOUD_ON_DEPARTURE` false), not designed here. **The berth is not silent to the Web (CD-GDD-ALIGN, stage 12; amended by the design review of 2026-10-27; OQ-WM-40: Resolved 2026-10-27 — user ruling D59, route 1: the `berth` verb declared LOUD with one `U_LOUD` push at the berth apply and `unberth` QUIET; the pusher is Interaction, re-review).** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling G1)* `berth` is the home-ship's own drive burning fuel (`BERTH_FUEL_ML` [PLACEHOLDER]) for `BERTH_TICKS` [PLACEHOLDER] to come alongside, the largest power-and-noise act in the MVP; P3 names power use and noise as what moves Attention, so a berth that cost Attention nothing would make growth a free action and weaken restraint as a strategy. **Attention declined the first route** (OQ-AT-23): a self-generated source keyed on `transit_state == BERTHING` would be a third intake path against AT-3, AT-4 and AT-25, so "this system pushes nothing and Attention models the burn" is withdrawn and ASK-A3 as worded is DECLINED. Attention's conforming routes were (1) the `berth` verb's declaration carries `noise_class` LOUD, pushed once at the berth apply, or (2) the Graph reports the drive's draw in `power_use`. **Route 1 is ruled** (Interaction IA-40: "Resolved 2026-10-27 — user ruling (design-review decisions): D59, route 1"). **Who pushes (resolved by delegated ruling G1: the channel owner and the registry's declared callers win): Interaction.** As channel owner, Interaction calls Attention's intake `push_stimulus(NOISE, source_ref = the home console section, LOUD)` once for the `berth` apply (IA-33 lists the berth apply among its LOUD one-shots, with cut completion, seam-cut DONE, vent apply and throw landing; IA-40 declares `berth` LOUD and `unberth` and `pod_hop` QUIET), and the registry's `push_stimulus` lists the Controller and Interaction as the only callers, with this system a zero-call negative reference. **This system makes 0 `push_stimulus` calls, always.** The earlier text in which this system pushed once, last in the berth apply, is withdrawn: with Interaction's declaration also pushing it would double the P3 event, and if each deferred to the other it would never be pushed. There is no `BERTH_LOUD` toggle here (the class is Interaction's `noise_class` declaration; the magnitude `U_LOUD` is Attention's) and no `NO_PUSH_OUTSIDE_BERTH` exception: the lint is now `NO_PUSH_STIMULUS` (zero `push_stimulus` calls in this system's scripts). The slot of the push (the berth apply tick or the next, relative to `attention.step`) is Interaction's and Attention's to state; this system's apply order is unchanged by it. **Counts, from any caller:** exactly **1** `push_stimulus(NOISE, ..., LOUD)` per `berth` apply that reaches `Applied`, **0** for a refused `berth`, and **0** per hop, per `unberth`, per `berth_step` and at `BERTHED`, so the hop stays the silent escape verb and the berth is the one loud act; this is the cross-system Integration criterion AC-WM-26b. A BREACH or TELL on the home body during BERTHING is not deferred or suppressed by this system. Needed from neighbours (cross-GDD notes, mirrored in OQ-WM-40): Attention confirms the intake slot; Adaptive Audio revisits the berth bed level (a LOUD act heard only as a -44 dBr tier-4 bed reads wrong, OQ-WM-46). *If the user later rules the berth silent or takes route 2:* Interaction's declaration changes, this system changes nothing, and AC-WM-81g records the gap. Re-entering a derelict: its Graph and Horror state resumes frozen (WM-25); the tell is Attention's and its clock ran during the absence. At the defaults a round trip is 2 x (`HOP_LEG_TICKS` 900 + `ARRIVE_SETTLE_TICKS` 45) = 1890 ticks, which exceeds `TELL_MAX_TICKS` 1800, so a tell running at departure has reached its due run, and been voided (AT-22), before any return; Attention owns the tell's fate (ASK-A2 answered by AT-22; AT E-27 on re-entry) *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*. *Cites.* AT-6, AT-22, AT E-23, E-27, E-73, V13, Moment B and C; AT `U_LOUD` and the `push_stimulus(NOISE, source_ref, class)` / `power_use` intake. *Pillar.* P2, P3. *Decided.* R16; stage 12 (ASK-A3).
**WM-26b — Derelicts freeze; HOME keeps running (the price of leaving).** *Rule.* A departed derelict freezes (dormant, WM-24). HOME and a berthed derelict keep running, because the Graph's clocks run whether or not the player acts (the earlier rationale 'nothing live runs unobserved' stays withdrawn) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*. One consequence is stated, not hidden: a leg plus settle is 945 ticks at the defaults (900 + 45), longer than the fairness window `W_MIN_WARNING_S` x `TICK_RATE` = 10 x 60 = 600 ticks (D.13), so a home fault that begins its warning as the seat departs can warn and fire entirely while the seat is in the pod. (The earlier consequence (1), 'a TELL-then-hop moves the due-run breach STRESS to the unwitnessed home ship', is DELETED: it described behaviour the user ruling OQ-AT-12 removed; a hop from a non-home locus ends the tell as ABORTED with no STRESS and a home-ship-locus tell is not escapable, WM-26, AT-22.) **Resolved 2026-10-28 — delegated ruling R21 (user delegated all remaining calls; applied under G6): the companion rule is WITHDRAWN and the exposure is accepted as the price of leaving.** The companion rule had two halves. Attention's half (hold the TELL-to-STRESS transfer while the seat is in the pod) was declined by Attention (AT-22) on the user ruling that a home-ship-locus breach proceeds as ruled and is not deferrable by hopping (E-73). The Graph's half (ASK-G5: defer arming new endogenous home failures while `transit_state` is LEG or ARRIVING) never received an answer (`life-support-graph.md` has no ASK-G5 and no OQ-WM-42), so it was unanswered, not accepted; adopting it alone would need the Graph (a Foundation system) to read Web Map's `transit_state` and would still let a fault already inside its 600-tick warning fire unwitnessed, so it is not a complete guarantee. The Graph's fairness gate (LS-13, `W_MIN_WARNING_S` 10 s of two-channel physical warning before any endogenous loss) still holds in the simulation; the pod window only means the player may not be present to read it. This is consistent with D60 (statuses run in the pod) and with the time-away costs E-62 and D.4 rely on. This GDD therefore asks nothing of the Graph or Attention for it. **Guards that remain:** the boolean lint `LEG_EXCEEDS_WINDOW` (true iff `n` + `ARRIVE_SETTLE_TICKS` + `IN_POD_SLACK_TICKS` > 600; 900 + 45 + 30 = 975 > 600, true at every default) reports the build state, and the playtest tripwire counts any home fault that fires with the seat IN_POD (telemetry `home_fault_fired_in_pod`, an observation, not a gate); if playtests make it frequent the levers are the leg and settle knobs of the Tuning Knobs section, not a new rule. The Tell bed stays audible during LEG (dread persists; the relief arrives at the arrival cut), a rule for Adaptive Audio (OQ-WM-46). *Cites.* AT-22, AT E-23, E-27, E-73, OQ-AT-12; LS-13; LS-17; D.13. *Pillar.* P2 (the fairness guarantee lives in the sim; the price of leaving is stated), P3. *Decided.* user ruling OQ-AT-12 (void confirmed; home-locus tell not voidable) plus delegated ruling R21, 2026-10-28. *(Amended 2026-10-28 — delegated ruling R21)*

**AT-10. Restraint aborts a tell.** *Rule.* During TELL, after each run's integration: if `L < theta_HOLD` then `below_hold_runs += 1`, else it resets to 0. The tell **aborts to CALM** when `below_hold_runs × 6 ≥ ABORT_HOLD_TICKS` (placeholder 120, run-quantised; the first run under the line counts as run 1), **or** at the first run with `T ≥ breach_due_T` if `L < theta_HOLD` at that run, **or** at that same run if the departure void holds (`locus_vacated`, AT-22; *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*). If both are true on the same run the abort wins (one transition). An abort deposits no STRESS, switches no beacon, sets `tell_outcome = ABORTED`, freezes `tell_beat`, leaves `L` unchanged (a knob `ABORT_RELIEF_PM` defaulting to 1000, which means "no relief" and means the abort is unchanged from the ruled behaviour, lets a tuner cap the level at an abort if playtests show chained-abort fatigue) and sets `rearm_until_T = T + TELL_REARM_TICKS` (placeholder 600). **The rearm keys on the item, not on the pickup** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5)*: while a TELL runs, Attention records in `tell_carry_items` (persisted, AT-1) the `carry_ref` of every seat whose `BURDEN` push it drained (an ordered read of `controller.state`, the same read as `loco_state`, AT-31); after an abort the set is kept until `rearm_until_T`. On any CALM run before `rearm_until_T` that drains a `BURDEN` push from a seat whose `carry_ref` is in the set, `rearm_until_T` is set to that run's `T`, so dropping the cargo to abort and taking the same item up again grants no fresh `TELL_REARM_TICKS` immunity: the next crossing opens a tell at once. A different item leaves the rearm in place. *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)* The test is the push, not the pickup: any CALM run before `rearm_until_T` that drains a `BURDEN` push from a seat whose `carry_ref` is in the set ends the rearm, whether the seat re-took the item or never put it down (a continuous hold). By the location gate of AT-3 the push is not drained `IN_POD` or aboard the home body, so a hauler who hops with the item is not charged here: the void sets `rearm_until_T = T_d + TELL_REARM_TICKS` (`T_d` the due run) and it holds through the pod leg and the home carry. The cancel can fire after a hop only if the seat is back aboard a non-home body still holding the item before `rearm_until_T`: that takes a round trip, 2 × (`HOP_LEG_TICKS` 900 + `ARRIVE_SETTLE_TICKS` 45) = 1,890 ticks from the hop, against a rearm that ends d + 600 ticks after the hop (d = ticks of the tell still to run at the hop), so it is reachable only when d > 1,890 − 600 = 1,290 (a hop in the first 510 ticks of an 1,800-tick tell); otherwise the rearm is whole. The narrower rule, that only a re-take cancels, is not adopted (creative-director lean). The set is cleared at TELL entry (and refilled during the tell), at BREACH entry (a breached tell sets no rearm) and when the rearm ends. A player who keeps being loud through the tell forfeits the abort; that is intended ("we chose to be loud"). Restraint always costs the partial (Formulas F-15b), and that price is deliberate *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*; it is balanced by a breach that has teeth (AT-11), so neither choice dominates. `tell_remaining` published to Save/Load is the time to `breach_due_T`: the conservative direction, because an abort only ends the block early. Two invariants, both lint: **(a) rearm against autosave:** `TELL_REARM_TICKS ≥ AUTOSAVE_RETRY_TICKS` (cited), which guarantees an open soft-gate window between chained aborted tells even under STRICT mode. **(b) abortability at entry:** a player who enters TELL at the highest possible level (`L_CEIL`, AT-5) and then zeroes every player-controlled input (still, beam off, no verbs, any cargo set down) falls under `theta_HOLD` minus a margin `ATT_MARGIN` before `TELL_MIN_TICKS − 6` ticks elapse, at the ring's survivable-dark floor. In words: the tell is a window of agency even at its shortest. The play-level variant, which adds a reaction allowance and evaluates against the shortest draw a player can actually meet, is the registered formula `abortability_play` (AT-8, CQ-4; Formulas F-15b).

1123	**Circularity check.** Attention reads the Graph's power phase (ordered `after: graph.propagate.power`) and calls its Class B mutator; the Graph reads nothing from Attention (LSG:281). Attention reads the Emitter State's list (ordered `after: emitter.place`) and submits a SYSTEM command at T+1; the Emitter State's only read of Attention is none. Lighting reads Attention's published tier and Attention reads nothing Lighting produces (LO:948), which resolves the index's soft cycle one-way. Horror's hook is `after` Attention and Attention reads nothing from Horror (Horror pushes no noise, HE-36; had it any, Class B calls inside a `WriteScope` would be inputs, not reads). Sanity reads Attention and Attention reads nothing from Sanity. The Controller pushes noise and Attention reads only `loco_state`; nothing in the Controller reads Attention. No cycle exists in the hook DAG: `suit.vitals → controller.step → body.integrate → emitter.place → attention.step`, and `graph.propagate.power → attention.step`, with Horror, Audio's polling subscriber and the Presenter downstream.

The Controller's GDD shows zero BURDEN hits, but the registry names it as the declared pusher for BURDEN. content.content:
**Output Range:** 42,000 mAU per run while holding (7 AU per tick), on top of the CARRY walk push of 6,000 per run when moving; the decay is suspended while the carry is held, so the level only rises and saturates at `L_CEIL` within the reference carry *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5)*. A run with no drained push has `pending_burden` clear, so the decay is not suspended in the pod or aboard the home body *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*.

**Why a new term and not new weights (the D50 recalibration, result).** The ruling asked for the weights and theta to be recalibrated so that an ordinary sortie reaches theta; that was run first, with the existing levers, and it does not close. Boarding's own finding (D.2) is that the lit golden sortie peaks at 57 percent of theta and that no retune of `U_TOOL`, `U_LOUD` or `TAU_ATT_TICKS` reaches it; getting there with `W_L`, `W_P` or `B_table` needs about 3.4 times today's intake, and the dark-floor lint forbids it: 3.4 times the unswitchable draw and EMERGENCY lamp term moves `r_dark` from 294 to about 1,000 mAU per tick, so `x_dark` = 300 + 1,000 × 1.8 = 2,100 AU against the F-15 cap of 1,253 AU; lowering `ATT_THRESHOLD` is bounded below at 5,816 AU (Tuning Knobs). A crossing that belongs to the take's own act therefore needs an intake that exists only while hauling. **Result of the recalibration: `W_L`, `W_P`, `W_S`, `B_table`, `TAU_ATT_TICKS` and `ATT_THRESHOLD` 6,000 are retained unchanged** (the lit sortie crosses at the current theta once the burden term exists), and the F-15, F-15b, F-16 and F-24 lints keep their inputs.

**Derivation of `U_BURDEN`.** Integer F-5 over Boarding's lit golden schedule (walk-in 312 ticks at 1 AU, door attempts 60 idle, the cut 240 ticks at `U_TOOL` with `U_LOUD` on its last tick, the pickup 12 idle, then the carry at the CARRY push plus the burden, then 30 idle ticks holding at the console), beam 288 and lit home 766 mAU per tick, from `L0`. The same model with no burden reproduces Boarding's golden peak (3,394,795 mAU, 3,374,965 after the console) exactly, which is the check that it is the same recursion. **Attention's walk-in convention (312 ticks, fixed) and its run accounting are canonical; Boarding quotes them** (R5). The decay is suspended on every carry run (F-5). *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5: one definition of each constraint, owned by Boarding & Salvage, stated with Attention's integrator; Attention's earlier K list and its private live-choice test `rem > TELL_DRAW_LO` are withdrawn.)* The constraints are **Boarding's K1 to K5** (Boarding D.2, AC-BS-123); Attention asserts only the crossing and reports the rest:

- **K1 crossing (asserted by IR-4).** The tell opens after the pickup and before the console.
- **K2 causality (reported).** The cut and the carry supply at least 50 percent of the headroom `theta − L0` at the tick the tell opens.
- **K3 live choice (Boarding's definition and pass line; reported here in permille).** At the opening the carry still ahead, `rem = Lc − t_open`, must be at least `TELL_DRAW_LO + F_LIVE × (TELL_DRAW_HI − TELL_DRAW_LO)`, which is 1,125 ticks at Boarding's provisional `F_LIVE` 0.25 (250 permille). Attention quotes the **live share** `live_pm = max(0, min(1000, (rem − TELL_DRAW_LO) × 1000 div (TELL_DRAW_HI − TELL_DRAW_LO)))`, the share of the tell draw for which walking on loses to the breach.
- **K4 restraint without the carry (reported).** The variants in which no salvage carry runs (cut and leave; listen and leave) stay at or below 0.95 `theta_HOLD`; the suspension never applies to them.
- **K5 priced freeze (reported).** With the cargo in hand the level never falls, so freezing after the cut is never free.
- **Abortable (Attention's).** The burden is zeroed by `drop`, so F-15 and F-15b keep their inputs (the carry paragraph of F-15b).

Results for the 28-tile carry (`Lc` 1,344, carry starts at schedule tick 624; mAU per tick of burden; decay suspended while held) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5)*:

| Burden | Tell opens (carry tick) | `rem` | live share (permille) | Boarding K3 (`rem` ≥ 1,125) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3,000 | 570 | 774 | 0 | no |
| 5,000 | 408 | 936 | 40 | no |
| 6,000 | 360 | 984 | 93 | no |
| **7,000 (`U_BURDEN` 7)** | **318** | **1,026** | **140** | **no** |
| 8,000 | 288 | 1,056 | 173 | no |
| 10,000 (top of the boot range) | 240 | 1,104 | 226 | no |
| 11,500 (outside the range) | 216 | 1,128 | 253 | yes |

With the decay suspended any burden of about 250 mAU per tick or more crosses inside the 28-tile carry (250 opens at carry tick 1,242; 0 never does), so K1 is easy. **No burden inside the boot range 7 to 10 meets Boarding's K3 at the 28-tile carry**; it needs about 11,500. `U_BURDEN` therefore stays **7** `[PLACEHOLDER]` (the ruling's 'about 7,000'), and Attention does not raise it, or any weight, to force K3 green (R5): the honest live share at 7 is 140 permille against Boarding's 250, and the pass line moves to the boarding spike (AC-BS-123(d) re-written as a spike gate, the outcome R5 names as expected). K5: with the cut done and the cargo held, standing still crosses 360 ticks after the pickup, and from the lit-idle level with no cut at all 540 ticks. K2: the tell opens at schedule tick 942; with the cut and carry pushes replaced by idle the level there would be 2,092,108, so the cut and the carry supply (6,000,000 − 2,092,108) / (6,000,000 − 1,678,501) = 90 percent of the headroom. The peak is `L_CEIL` (6,120,000, 1.02 `theta`), which is as high as any run can go.

**Worked example (`U_BURDEN` 7, `Lc` 1,344).** At the start of the carry `L` = 3,144,759 mAU (after the walk-in, the cut with its `LOUD` push and the pickup). One carry run adds `6 × (1,000 + 7,000 + 288 + 766)` = 54,324 mAU and, with the decay suspended, loses nothing, so `L'` = 3,199,083; the level reaches `theta` on the 53rd run (6,023,931 mAU), 318 ticks in, with `rem` 1,026 ticks of carry still ahead *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5)*. A tell opened there lasts 900 to 1,800 ticks: for the 126 draws of 900 to 1,025 walking on arrives after the breach (140 permille of the draw); for every longer draw it arrives first, so the choice is live but thin, below Boarding's 250-permille line, which is why the unit carries a `[PLACEHOLDER]` tag and why the length of the carry matters more than the unit.

**What the burden does to the restraint variants.** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5: decay suspended while held.)* With the beam off the tell opens 348 ticks into the carry, with the home lamps dark (start level 829,000) 432, with both 468; `rem` is then 996, 912 and 876 (live shares 106, 13 and 0 permille), so none meets Boarding's K3 and none avoids the tell. Light restraint does not save a hauler; setting the cargo down, or not cutting and hauling in the first place, does (a bare haul from the lit-idle level crosses in 480 ticks, so any salvage haul longer than 10 tiles from that level tells). Boarding's acceptance shape must be re-derived accordingly (notes for the Boarding owner). **A berth that costs `U_LOUD`** (OQ-AT-23, default applied) moves the opening to 306 ticks into the carry (`rem` 1,038, live share 153 permille).

**The reference carry is the lever Attention does not own.** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5.)* At `U_BURDEN` 7 the tell opens 318 ticks into any carry of the ruled band, so Boarding's K3 needs `Lc` ≥ 1,125 + 318 = 1,443 ticks (30.1 tiles), beyond the ruled 21-to-28 tiles (Derelict Authoring's route, X3), and any live share at all needs `Lc` ≥ `TELL_DRAW_LO` + 318 + 1 = 1,219 ticks (25.4 tiles). A 21-tile carry (1,008 ticks) leaves `rem` 690, fits every tell and offers no live choice; making it live at all would need the tell to open within 107 ticks of the pickup, a burden above 20,000 mAU per tick, which nobody should want. Whether the choice is live is therefore Derelict Authoring's pick of the reference route, not Attention's unit.

**Lints.** `carry_decision` (IR-4, a CI data-lint over the reference derelict's `Lc` and `assets/data/attention/intake.json`): *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5.)* K1 holds on the lit golden schedule (the tell opens inside the carry), else `ATT_CARRY_NO_CROSSING` (ERROR); the live share is computed and reported against Boarding's K3 line as `ATT_CARRY_NOT_LIVE` (WARN, boot-advisory: the pass line belongs to the boarding spike, AC-BS-123(d), so IR-4, AC-AT-132 and Boarding's `REF_GOLDEN` assertion (d) are **not story-ready** as pass/fail gates until that spike sets it); the burden range 7 to 10 is a boot range lint (`U_BURDEN` 6 and 11 refuse boot). At 10 a bare salvage haul from the lit-idle level tells within 360 ticks (7.5 tiles), which is the 'too high' edge. Registry: `U_BURDEN`, the class list of `noise_push` and the two formulas are requested (Cross-References).

## Edge Cases

*Each entry reads "If [condition]: [exact outcome]. [rationale]" and names the diagnostic or reason code where one exists. Entries are grouped by theme; `E-n` ids are stable references for the Acceptance Criteria. Rule ids are `AT-n`, formulas `F-n`. Provisional entries say which sibling or undesigned system they depend on.*

If the locus section is cut away or goes dormant mid-event, the locus falls back per AT-14 and the locus body is recomputed (never as the consequence of a departure, which the void above resolves first); STRESS already armed on a cut-away section lapses on its own hold. **A death in the pod** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* *(user ruling D60, 2026-10-27)*: statuses run in the pod (Suit's air, cell, thermal and counters, and the Sanity and Attention clocks, all keep running) and a seat that dies there is the Controller's `DEAD`; Attention reads that through `loco_state` (AT-31), so a seat in the pod is living until then, a dead one stops counting for `B` and for the pod hold, and if it was the last recorded occupant of a non-home locus its section had already left `locus_body`, so the departure clauses already hold. **Ordering in BREACH:** the departure
